name: Holy Spirit Shield
desc: Can be triggered in combat state and obtains a shield equal to 4.09% of HP, 10 seconds (CD: 60s)

name: Survival Instinct
desc: Triggers upon taking damage whenHP is below 50%, Tenacity+4.44%, Block+4.44%, DEF+8.88%, 10 seconds. (CD: 20s)

name: Crisis Warning
desc: When taking damage, if the damage is greater than 6% of the player's max HP, Block will definitely be triggered, and the Damage Reduction efficiency of the Block will be increased by 15.2%. (CD: 20s)

name: Wind-following Shadow
desc: After using the Dodge skill, damage dealt +2.02%, damage taken -3.03%, 3 seconds

name: Good luck follows
desc: Good Luck Follows: Triggers every 15s in combat, and gets 1 of the following effects randomly: ATK+5.44% for 6s, DEF+10.88% for 6s, 6% MaxHP heal.

name: Integrated Offense and Defense
desc: When HP > 50%, damage taken by the character -8.19%, When HP >= 50%, damage dealt by the character +5.46%

name: Flower Barrier
desc: Flower Fairy damage taken reduced by 3.03%

name: Full Moon
desc: For every 10% HP remaining, obtain 0.56% Damage Reduction; when HP > 80%, obtain additional 3% Damage reduction

name: Impeccable
desc: Crit damage taken is reduced by 20.48%
